Texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information visit
Texts.Hero:Title: The Smarter Way to Move Goods Across Cities
Texts.Hero:Description: A fully automated logistics platform that connects service requesters with verified trucks and drivers—through smart bidding, real-time tracking, and secure escrow payments.
Texts.Trust:Title: Built for Speed, Trust & Transparency
Texts.Trust:RealTimeTrackingDesc: Monitor your shipment from pickup to delivery with a live map and instant status updates.
Texts.Trust:SmartBiddingDesc: Receive competitive offers from drivers and choose the best price, timing, and truck type.
Texts.Trust:SecureEscrowDesc: We hold your payment securely and release it only after successful delivery confirmation.
Texts.Trust:VerifiedTrucksDriversDesc: Every truck and driver undergoes ID, license, and registration verification.
Texts.Trust:AllTruckTypesDesc: Trailers – Flatbeds – Refrigerated Trucks – Heavy-Duty Vehicles.
Texts.Trust:ForCompaniesIndividualsDesc: Suitable for factories, warehouses, businesses, and personal shipments.
Texts.Features:Title: Main Platform Features
Texts.Features:Subtitle: Everything you need to manage your logistics operations efficiently and transparently
Texts.Features:TripCreationDesc: Create your transport request in minutes with detailed filters (weight, dimensions, truck type, goods type, temperature…).
Texts.Features:ReceiveBidsDesc: Drivers near you submit offers—compare prices and select the best fit.
Texts.Features:LiveMapTrackingDesc: Know exactly where your shipment is at any moment with GPS tracking.
Texts.Features:OTPConfirmationDesc: Confirm delivery securely using a one-time code (OTP).
Texts.Features:RateDriverDesc: Share your experience and help improve service quality.
Texts.Features:TruckOwnerModuleDesc: Add trucks, upload documents, link drivers, and manage your fleet.
Texts.HowItWorks:Title: How It Works
Texts.HowItWorks:Subtitle: Four Simple Steps to Move Your Goods
Texts.HowItWorks:Step1Desc: Select pickup and drop-off locations, cargo details, and required truck type.
Texts.HowItWorks:Step2Desc: Drivers submit prices—compare bids and choose your best option.
Texts.HowItWorks:Step3Desc: Watch your shipment move in real time on the map.
Texts.HowItWorks:Step4Desc: Enter OTP when goods arrive; payment is then released automatically to the driver.
Texts.Drivers:Title: Earn More. Drive Smarter.
Texts.Drivers:Description: Join a platform that brings you high-quality trips every day. Submit your bid, get selected, and start earning instantly.
Texts.Fleet:Title: Manage Your Fleet with Confidence
Texts.Fleet:Description: Add trucks, manage documents, assign drivers, and track all trips from one place. Our comprehensive fleet management system gives you complete control over your operations.
Texts.Enterprise:Title: Reliable Logistics for Large-Scale Operations
Texts.Enterprise:Subtitle: Power your business with enterprise-grade logistics solutions designed for scale, reliability, and complete transparency.
Texts.Enterprise:DashboardDesc: Comprehensive analytics, fleet management, and real-time monitoring all in one place.
Texts.Enterprise:UserManagementDesc: Manage team access, roles, and permissions with ease.
Texts.Enterprise:AnalyticsDesc: Deep insights into your logistics operations and performance metrics.
Texts.Enterprise:ComplianceDesc: Stay compliant with automated documentation and reporting.
Texts.Pricing:Title: Transparent and Flexible
Texts.Pricing:Subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your needs
Texts.Testimonials:Title: Trusted by Thousands
Texts.Testimonials:Subtitle: See what our users have to say about their experience
Texts.Testimonials:Quote1: Finally a platform that makes trucking simple. The bidding system saves us time and money on every shipment.
Texts.Testimonials:Quote2: Real-time tracking changed everything for us. Our clients love knowing exactly where their goods are at all times.
Texts.Testimonials:Quote3: Good pay, good trips, no middlemen. The platform is straightforward and payments are always on time.
Texts.Footer:Description: The smarter way to move goods across cities. Connecting service requesters with verified trucks and drivers through smart technology.
